title: The intern screen now runs before anyone reads your résumé
subtitle: Many software internships now send a coding assessment before a human looks at you. Here is how to reorder your preparation.

publication.name: Level Up Coding
publication.pitch: A student's take on the Summer 2027 internship cycle: at many large employers the coding assessment now arrives before anyone reads the résumé, so preparation should be reordered to match. The piece is written from my own application season, hedges what is reported versus confirmed, and ends with a five-step preparation order readers can use this week.

cover_image.alt: A student working on a laptop at a desk, with a timer visible beside the keyboard.

seo_description: Many software internships now send a coding test before anyone reads your résumé. How students should reorder their preparation for it.
